newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Bozano, Simonsen launches 7.5 bln esc bond.
newsitem.headline: Banco Bozano, Simonsen launches 7.5 bln esc bond.

text.p: Banco Bozano, Simonsen SA, Cayman Branch, is launching a three-year 7.5 billion escudo Navigator bond indexed to six-month Lisbor plus 335 basis points, announced joint lead managers Banco Santander de Negocios Portugal (BSNP), Banco ESSI and Banco Finantia.
"The nominal interest rate of the issue will be indexed to six-month Lisbor plus 335 basis points (bp), with payment of interest every six months," a statement said.
"The term of the bonds will be three years, with settlement of the operation on September 27 1996," it added.
It said "The issue of bonds in the Navigator market will take place under the Euro Medium-Term Notes programme of Banco Bozano, Simonsen SA, and is expected to be quoted on Luxembourg bourse."
Banco Totta & Acores is senior co-lead manager of the issue.
